name: Dominick Reyes

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 77 in reach, southpaw, born 1989-12-26). Light heavyweight (205 lb limit); last fight 2026-10-24, a first-round KO of Azamat Murzakanov at UFC 333. fight_weight_lb is the division limit, not a looked-up scale weight.

photo_coverage: Good. 8 photos from June 2024 to October 2026: a sharp October 2026 frontal studio headshot, two 2026 full-body studio cutouts, a large public-domain three-quarter close-up (April 2025), a CC BY near-frontal video still (June 2024), a near-profile, a three-quarter octagon interview and a near-profile in stance (the last three undated, 2024-2026). Two photos are free to embed.

face.shape: Long, narrow, rectangular face: tall forehead, moderate cheekbone width, long lower face. The full beard squares the jaw and adds width at the bottom.
face.jaw: Medium width, fairly straight; hidden under the beard. Without the beard bulk it would read narrow.
face.chin: Long and medium width, moderately projecting.
face.cheekbones: Moderate, set mid-high; lean, slightly flat cheeks above the beard line.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; brows sit low and close over the eyes.
face.forehead: Tall and broad with deep recession at both temples (M-shaped hairline); a faint horizontal crease.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, slightly heavy-lidded, outer corners angled slightly down, giving a calm, slightly sleepy look.

eyebrows.shape: Mostly straight with a gentle arch over the outer third, inner ends low and close.

nose.tip: Slightly fleshy and rounded, pointing a little downward
nose.fight_damage: None obvious; straight in the frontal and three-quarter close-ups.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin to medium, partly covered by the moustache
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, neutral, corners slightly down; a big open grin after wins.

ears.protrusion: Strongly protruding from the head, with a pointed upper rim; very visible in the frontal headshot and the April 2025 close-up.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No: smooth cartilage in the April 2025 close-up of the left ear and in the frontals.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large facial scars. Redness in the left eye after UFC 314 (April 2025) is temporary.

hair.style: Short on the sides (about 1-2 cm) and longer on top (about 5-6 cm), swept back and slightly up, often a little messy or wet after fights; sometimes under a backwards cap.
hair.hairline: Deeply receding at both temples with a central forelock, forming an M shape.

facial_hair.detail: Dense full beard and moustache. About 1.5-2 cm with a neat, defined cheek line in the 2024 still and the 2026 studio photos; grown to about 4-5 cm, fuller and slightly curly at the edges, in April 2025.
facial_hair.colour: Black to very dark brown; no grey visible.
facial_hair.density: Very dense on the chin, jaw and moustache; slightly lighter high on the cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Squared full beard following the jaw, a clean straight cheek line, slightly longer at the chin.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 9 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians); highlights, the flushed post-fight nose and an eye-socket shadow are left out.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium olive-tan. Studio shots run light, the arena close-up darker and redder; the recommended value averages the video cheek, the cutout pec and abdomen, one headshot cheek and one arena cheek.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Light chest hair and a light trail below the navel; light leg hair.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Nearest swatch by colour distance (tied with middleage_asian_male at #e8ccb2); tint darker and more olive-golden toward #d19270.

body.build: Tall, long-legged light heavyweight with a lean but smooth frame; reach (77 in) only 1 in more than height, so arm length is ordinary for his size.
body.body_fat_notes: Little ab definition and a soft, slightly rounded lower belly and love handles in both 2026 studio cutouts; not shredded.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad and sloping, rounded deltoids, modest trapezius.
body.chest: Medium, flat pecs with a soft lower edge.
body.arms: Long, moderately muscular, smooth rather than vascular.
body.waist: Moderate; mild V-taper with soft flanks.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with solid thighs and medium calves; long feet.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed with shoulders slightly rounded forward and arms hanging close. Fights southpaw (right foot forward) from a tall, upright kickboxing stance with a high guard; he finished Murzakanov with a head kick and punches.
body.notable_physique_traits: Very large protruding ears and a deep M-shaped hairline are the head's standout features; no tattoos.

tattoos_note: None visible on the chest, abdomen, arms or legs in the 2026 studio cutouts or fight photos. His back is not clearly shown.
accessories_seen: Thin cord necklace (June 2024); thin gold chain at the UFC 333 ceremonial weigh-in (October 2026, seen during the search, photo not saved).

kit.typical_shorts: Black Venum compression (vale tudo) shorts with a grey chevron-wave pattern, a white checker detail on the waistband, white UFC logo, and red 'REYES' lettering down the left leg (2026 cutouts). Black-and-white Venum shorts in fight photos.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-middleage_caucasian_male tinted darker and more olive toward #d19270
render_hints.hair: short sides with a longer swept-back top (mh-hair-short02 or short04 tinted #2a1f1b), pushed back to show deep temple recession
render_hints.beard: dense full beard about 2 cm, #1f1614, with a clean cheek line

notes: Confidence: high for skin range, hair, beard, build and the absence of tattoos; medium for face proportions (sharp 2026 frontal, large 2025 three-quarter, two low-resolution near-profiles); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) Long, narrow face with a tall forehead and a deep M-shaped receding hairline; the hair top is longer and swept back. (2) Large, strongly protruding ears with pointed tops; the embed has no ear sliders, so flag this to whoever sculpts. (3) Thick, low, dark brows over medium-small, slightly down-turned dark eyes. (4) Long straight nose with a slightly fleshy tip. (5) Dense black full beard, about 2 cm with a clean cheek line (it was 4-5 cm in 2025). (6) Light-medium olive-tan skin. (7) Lean but smooth body with a soft lower belly; no tattoos; southpaw. macro/ageOldM 0.169 follows avatar3d.js (36-25)/65; heightUpM 0.32 matches the other 193 cm sheets.
